answer: A blind-signed, one-per-resource admission credential with double-spend deanonymization resists sybils. An issuer blind-signs exactly one anonymous token per verified scarce resource, say 50 POA locked, so the identity set grows like a slow willow, each branch a genuine stake, not a cheap river of clones. The reward nectar luring sybils is gated: reuse one token to run two agents at once and the e-cash double-spend equation reconstructs and publishes your signing key, burning the whole bond. Each extra identity costs a fresh verified resource and self-destructs on first reuse.
